newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.80 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.80 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed unchanged at 14.80 ringgit ($5.86) a kg for the third straight day on support from European and local buyers despite an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
"There were initially more sellers but when the price dipped below 14.80, they withdrew and the market closed unchanged," said a trader. "There was also some good support from buyers."
Final turnover was 92 tonnes compared to 76 tonnes on Thursday and was absorbed by European and local interests. The local premium against London rose to $45 a tonne from $25.
